meta.parties: Appuhamy Et Al. v. Mohammado Lebbe

rules.statement: A grantor cannot validly reserve an absolute unfettered power to revoke a grant of land in perpetuity at any time for any purpose.
rules.supporting_quote: "In my opinion, as the two declarations are inconsistent, and as the first is quite clear and the second is doubtful, we must give effect to the first, and hold that there is no absolute unfettered power of revocation at any time."
